newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-WILLEMS PUTS DERBY ON ROAD TO VICTORY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-WILLEMS PUTS DERBY ON ROAD TO VICTORY.

text.p: A first minute strike by Dutchman Ron Willems put newly promoted Derby on the road to their first English premier league win on Monday and plunged Blackburn deep into relegation trouble with their fourth defeat of the season.
Blackburn drew level only 10 minutes later through a goal by Chris Sutton, making his first senior appearance of the season after injuring his ankle.

But with only five minutes remaining Derby substitute Marco Gabbiadini managed to make space in the penalty area and set up substitute Sean Flynn, who took his time before curving a shot beyond goalkeeper Tim Flowers.
It was Blackburn's third successive home defeat and left them second from last in the premier league with only one point from the opening five matches of the season.
Derby's win took them to mid-table with six points.
